source.kind: User-supplied diagnostic log; only sanitized aggregates are published

context: Completed MDK2 capture using the restored K-UI launcher and optimized display clear. This is physical evidence for runtime 8bae3efe7c2f, not for the subsequent destination-browser feature package.

capture.console_result: CAPTURED: all 31 tracks; stream CRC32 recorded; saved data NOT re-read

ui_census.meaning: Scheduled time of the whole main/UI thread, not redraw duration alone. This interval encloses core setup/capture/finish and excludes outer disc preparation, settings refresh and report saving. It overlaps per-stage wall timers.

comparison.interpretation: The new MDK2 run reaches about 96.3% of the accepted same-disc capture rate, with about 46 seconds added to a roughly 20-minute operation. The additional UI scheduled time nearly equals the additional operation wall time, supporting residual UI overhead. The 12.4% to 8.3% comparison uses different games and is descriptive, not a controlled measurement of the display-clear change. These results do not call for redesigning or rebenchmarking the accepted reader.

limitations: Reference matching uses captured-stream CRC32. Saved tracks were not reread and no PC verification was supplied for this job.

There are no capture retry messages, and the PIO subreport records zero retries/timeouts. A preparatory command failure precedes the successful capture; this is not a claim that every command in the entire session succeeded.
The duplicate DMA/PIO summary describes the same operation, not two sets of reads.
UI scheduled time overlaps write/hash stage wall times and must not be added to them as a separate cost.
Same-disc comparisons across sessions support an overhead diagnosis but do not isolate individual UI drawing costs or guarantee an exact recoverable speed gain.
The source report's raw text, hardware identifiers, card geometry and storage paths are intentionally excluded from this aggregate.
